One crocodile is lying on its side with its mouth open, while the other is positioned on top of it, also with its mouth open. The background shows a body of water, likely a river or lake. The text overlay on the image reads: "Crocodiles do not die of old age, because they do not age biologically. Instead they die of either starvation or a disease." The post has received 3,544 likes.
